subject: Post-call: Infosec checklist & next steps for Fintrax
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Yang <alice.yang@fintrax.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + infosec checklist (Fintrax)

Hi Alice — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our SDR/technical discovery and the items you asked us to follow up on. I’ve bolded the immediate asks.

Summary of pain points you confirmed
- Auditability: You need per-request audit logs ingestible by your SIEM with at least 365-day retention.
- Compliance posture: SOC 2 Type II report required for vendor onboarding; you also want evidence around our change control and incident response playbooks.
- Data handling: Clarify retention and deletion options for KV caches and stored prompts; want contractual guarantees in the DPA.
- Pen test: You'd like the latest external penetration test summary and clarification on remediation windows.

Primary goals
1) Complete security review for vendor approval by Dec 8 so procurement can start PO paperwork.
2) Pilot a dedicated workload with audit-log streaming to your splunk ingestion endpoint.
3) Agree DPA redlines and SLA (latency SLOs) before contract signature.

Immediate asks (what we promised today)
- Alice: Please confirm the SIEM ingestion format (syslog/HTTPS json) and retention policy required.
- Fintrax security: We'll deliver a redacted SOC 2 Type II report, pen-test executive summary, and our MAP (mutual action plan) that includes a timeline for evidence delivery.

Next steps (owner / ETA)
- Sean: Upload redacted SOC 2 + pen-test exec notes, share MAP and initial DPA redline by EOD 11/20.
- Monica: Coordinate a technical onboarding call w/ your security engineer to validate audit log schema (target 11/24).
- Fintrax: Confirm procurement lead + any special legal clauses by 11/25.

Attachments I will drop in this thread: MAP-Fintrax-20261120.docx (MAP), SOC2_Redacted_Finserv.pdf (redacted), PenTest_Summary_ExecNotes.pdf (exec summary), DPA_Redline_Fintrax.docx (initial redline).

If that matches your reading, I’ll send the files now. Happy to adjust timeframe if you need a faster cadence.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
---
Redwood Inference | https://www.redwood.ai

From: Alice Yang <alice.yang@fintrax.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintrax.com, procurement@fintrax.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + infosec checklist (Fintrax)

Sean — thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with our notes. A couple clarifications from security: **we require audit log retention configurable to 13 months** and an option to stream in near real-time to our HTTPS ingestion endpoint (token-auth). We’ll send the exact sample payload by EOD.

A few priority questions (so we can triage internally):
1) Can Redwood produce per-request identifiers that we can correlate to our internal user IDs?
2) What are your default retention/TTL options for model KV cache and stored prompts? We need the option to auto-delete after 30/90/365 days and a contractual guarantee to honor deletion requests.
3) For pen testing: do you have scope-limited reports (exec summary only) suitable for sharing with procurement/legal?

Procurement: please note Fintrax needs vendor onboarding completed before Dec 10 to hit our Q4 rollout date.

Please send the redacted SOC2 and pen-test exec notes as promised. We’ll review and route to our third-party risk team.

Regards,
Alice Yang
Security Program Manager, Fintrax Payments
alice.yang@fintrax.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Yang <alice.yang@fintrax.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + infosec checklist (Fintrax)

Thanks Alice — attaching the items we discussed. See inline answers to your numbered questions and an updated MAP with owners + dates.

Inline answers
1) Per-request identifiers: Yes — Redwood can emit a request_id header (UUID v4) and surface an optional customer_user_id field if provided in the request metadata. We’ll include mapping guidance in the tech onboarding doc.
2) Retention/TTL: By default hosted requests are retained for 30 days, and KV cache is session-scoped with configurable retention. For Dedicated/Private deployments we provide configurable retention policies: 30 / 90 / 365 days or customer-managed deletion on demand. We will add contractual language to the DPA.
3) Pen test reports: We can share an executive summary and a redacted remediation tracker suitable for procurement/legal review; full reports are restricted.

Attachments included (redacted where appropriate):
- MAP-Fintrax-20261120.docx (mutual action plan with dates & owners)
- SOC2_Redacted_Finserv.pdf (redacted SOC 2 Type II pack)
- PenTest_Summary_ExecNotes.pdf (high-level findings and remediation windows)
- DPA_Redline_Fintrax.docx (our initial redline to expedite legal review)

Immediate ask for Fintrax security: please confirm the HTTPS payload sample and a contact for the ingestion endpoint (host + token).

Proposed timeline (from MAP)
- 11/20: Redwood delivers evidence + DPA redline (done).
- 11/24: Technical onboarding call for log schema (Redwood + Fintrax sec eng).
- 11/27: Fintrax feeds security review feedback to Redwood legal.
- 12/2: Final DPA sign-off and procurement gives PO.

If that looks good I’ll schedule the onboarding call; Monica will coordinate availability.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(sean.gallagher@redwood.com)

Attachment stubs: SOC2_Redacted_Finserv.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB redacted), PenTest_Summary_ExecNotes.pdf (pdf, 450KB), MAP-Fintrax-20261120.docx (docx), DPA_Redline_Fintrax.docx (docx)

From: Alice Yang <alice.yang@fintrax.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintrax.com, procurement@fintrax.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + infosec checklist (Fintrax)

Sean / Monica — received the package and thanks for the clear MAP. I confirmed with our sec team: the sample payload schema will be sent by Karan (sec engineer) tomorrow morning. Procurement looped in — they’ll start internal approvals once the DPA redline is reviewed.

A couple quick notes from our side after a quick skim of the attachments:
- SOC2: redacted summary is sufficient for first pass; we’ll request a limited-scope bridge letter if procurement needs more assurance.
- PenTest: exec notes look fine; we’ll request the remediation window on medium/high findings for SLA alignment.
- DPA redline: legal will push back on deletion language; we’ll provide redlines by 11/25.

Next actions agreed
- Fintrax security (Karan): send sample payload by 11/21 EOD.
- Redwood (Sean/Monica): schedule technical onboarding call for 11/24; circulate calendar invite and pre-read.
- Procurement (Fintrax): route DPA to legal and respond with redlines by 11/25.

If anything changes we’ll update the thread. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice Yang
Security Program Manager, Fintrax Payments
alice.yang@fintrax.com
